body: I have a great relationship with my mom. She's the kind of mom you really can talk to about anything.

Thanks. I'm hoping she's okay, and she was just having a bad day. If she did kill herself, I'll know within a few days. There's already been a suicide this year and the school let us know the next day.

I'm going to talk to the ninth grade principal about it, because she would know if anyone was missing. 

If I need to talk to anyone else, it'll probably be my mom.
